veld-pv-1-1-doeltjes.uitleg: Two players play 1v1. Each player defends two mini goals and attacks the other player's two goals. Be brave and take them on: use a feint and pick the goal that is open. After a goal, the other player gets the ball.
veld-pv-1-1-doeltjes.organisatie: 13 × 18 m area with two mini goals (2–3 m wide) in the corners of both short sides. Waiting pairs beside the area; each round lasts 45–60 seconds.
coachpunten: Run at the defender with speed, then make your move
Look up: which goal is the defender leaving open?
Defender: don't dive in, stay on your toes, side-on, and force the attacker one way

makkelijker: One bigger goal at each end
moeilijker: A goal only counts after a feint or a cut

veld-pv-2-1.uitleg: Two attackers start at 26 m and play against one defender and a keeper. Dribble at the defender to commit them, then pass to your teammate and go in behind: with a one-two the defender is beaten. If the defender wins the ball, they can score in a mini goal on the halfway line.
veld-pv-2-1.organisatie: On half a pitch: attackers with a ball at 26 m, defender at 16 m, keeper in goal. Mini goal on the halfway line for the defender. Rotate after each attack.
coachpunten: Ball carrier: dribble at the defender until they have to choose
Teammate: stay wide, don't run towards the ball
Go in behind straight after your pass: the return comes into your path

makkelijker: The defender only starts after the first pass
moeilijker: A second defender comes on from the side after 3 seconds (2v2)
A goal only counts after a one-two

veld-pv-2-2-winnaar-blijft.uitleg: Two against two on two mini goals. The pair that scores stays on; the pair that concedes goes off and a new pair comes on. Work together: a pass and a run behind the defender (overlap or in behind) often leads to a goal.
veld-pv-2-2-winnaar-blijft.organisatie: 22 × 14 m area with a mini goal (3 m) on each short side. Pairs wait beside the area; changes happen at the side.
coachpunten: Off the ball: run behind your opponent, not towards the ball
Play the ball into your teammate's path
Defending: one presses, the other tracks the run

makkelijker: Change every 2 minutes instead of after a goal
moeilijker: A goal only counts after a pass
With a keeper in each goal

veld-pv-3-2-omschakeling.uitleg: Three attackers play against two defenders and a keeper on the full-size goal. As soon as the defenders or the keeper win the ball, they switch to attack: they can score in the two mini goals on the halfway line, and the attackers have to defend straight away.
veld-pv-3-2-omschakeling.organisatie: Half pitch with keeper. Two mini goals on the halfway line, 12 m apart. Attackers start with the ball at 26 m, defenders at 16 m.
coachpunten: Attackers: use the overload quickly, move the ball to the free player
Defenders: cover the most dangerous line and wait for the mistake
When you win it: first pass forwards, and support the attack straight away

makkelijker: Defenders score with a pass through a gate instead of in mini goals
moeilijker: After losing the ball, all three attackers can defend
Two extra keepers: in the mini goals as well

veld-pv-3-2-omschakeling.meerSpelers: With more players: change one group after each attack, or set up a second pitch.

veld-pv-3-3-vier-doeltjes.uitleg: Each team defends two mini goals in the corners and attacks the other team's two goals. Play down one side to draw the opponents across, then switch quickly to the goal that is open.
veld-pv-3-3-vier-doeltjes.organisatie: 24 × 20 m area with a mini goal (2.5 m) in each corner. Two teams of three in bibs; 3-minute rounds.
coachpunten: Check the far goal before the ball reaches you
Get wide when you have the ball: then the opponents have to shift a long way
Defend as a unit and shift across to the ball side

moeilijker: A goal on the opposite side to where the attack started counts double

veld-pv-3-3-vier-doeltjes.meerSpelers: With 7 players: a joker who plays for the team in possession. With 8 or more: 4v4 or a second area.

veld-pv-4-4-keepers.uitleg: A 4v4 game with two keepers on two youth goals. The keeper starts the attack with a throw; the team builds up patiently, finds the striker and the striker lays it off to a teammate arriving. Free play, focusing on combination play.
veld-pv-4-4-keepers.organisatie: 28 × 36 m pitch with a youth goal (5 × 2 m) and a keeper at each end. Teams in bibs, 4–5-minute rounds.
coachpunten: Build-up: get wide and let the keeper throw it out to the free player
Striker: come short, lay it off, then spin in behind
After losing the ball, the nearest player presses straight away

makkelijker: The keeper may also join in as an outfield player
moeilijker: A goal within 10 seconds of winning the ball counts double

veld-pv-4-4-keepers.meerSpelers: With 9 players: a joker. With more: 5v5 on a bigger pitch, or rotate every 3 minutes.

veld-pv-5-5-flank.naam: 5v5 with keepers: goals from the wing count double
veld-pv-5-5-flank.uitleg: A 5v5 game with keepers. There is a wide channel along each touchline. A goal from a cross or pass out of a wide channel counts double. This teaches players to make the pitch big and attack down the flanks.
veld-pv-5-5-flank.organisatie: 34 × 44 m pitch with two youth goals and keepers. 6 m wide channels along the touchlines (cones or disc cones). Teams in bibs.
coachpunten: Make the pitch wide: one player on each wing
Cross: first look who is attacking the box (near post, far post)
Strikers: don't arrive in the box too early, come in with speed

makkelijker: No defending in the wide channels
moeilijker: Only goals from the wing count
Two touches maximum in the wide channel
Defenders may also enter the wide channel (1v1)

veld-pv-5-5-flank.meerSpelers: With 11 players: a joker. With more: rotate subs every 3 minutes, or two pitches side by side.

veld-pv-scoren-na-kaats.naam: 3v3 + bounce players: score only after a one-two
veld-pv-scoren-na-kaats.uitleg: Three against three on two mini goals, with two bounce players on the touchlines who always play for the team in possession. A goal only counts if the attack includes a one-two, with a teammate or a bounce player.
veld-pv-scoren-na-kaats.organisatie: 20 × 26 m area with a mini goal (3 m) on each short side. Bounce players (purple) in the middle of both touchlines. Change the bounce players every round.
coachpunten: Accelerate straight after your pass to the bounce player: the ball comes back into your path
Bounce players: return it first time, onto the runner's foot
Defenders: follow the runner, not the ball

makkelijker: You can score without a one-two too, but with one it counts double
Bounce players may take two touches
moeilijker: A goal only counts after a one-two with a bounce player

veld-pv-scoren-na-kaats.meerSpelers: With more players: extra bounce players on the touchline, or 4v4 with the bounce players.

veld-pv-lijnvoetbal.uitleg: Two teams of four. You score by dribbling the ball over the other team's end line. There are no goals, so the whole width is the 'goal': find space, be brave in the 1v1 and dribble through.
veld-pv-lijnvoetbal.organisatie: 26 × 30 m pitch; the short sides are the scoring lines (cones on the corners). Teams in bibs, 3-minute rounds.
coachpunten: Look for space beside or behind the last defender
On the ball: pick your moment to accelerate
Defending: stay together, leave no gaps between you

makkelijker: You can also score with a pass to a player behind the line
moeilijker: Dribble over the line and stop the ball with your sole on it
Score only in the two 5 m zones by the touchlines

veld-pv-lijnvoetbal.meerSpelers: With 9 players: a joker. With more: 5v5 on a wider pitch, or a second area.

veld-cv-1t1-2t1.uitleg: The attacker beats the first defender with a feint. Then it becomes 2v1: they dribble at the second defender to commit them and pass to their supporting teammate, who finishes.
veld-cv-1t1-2t1.organisatie: First defender at 27 m, second at 15 m. The second attacker starts on the wing at 24 m. Attackers and defenders swap roles after each attack.
coachpunten: 1v1: run at the defender with speed, make your move and then accelerate
2v1: dribble until the defender has to choose, only then pass
Supporting attacker: stay wide and don't come inside too early

makkelijker: The first defender only half-defends (just runs alongside)
The second defender only starts when the pass is played
moeilijker: The first defender may sprint back (2v2)
8 seconds maximum for the whole attack

veld-ps-3-2-poortjes.uitleg: Three attackers play against two defenders and score by dribbling the ball through one of the two end gates. Use the overload: draw a defender towards you and pass to the free player.
veld-ps-3-2-poortjes.organisatie: 20 × 24 m pitch. Two 3 m gates on the end line. Attackers start with the ball on the other end line, defenders on the halfway line. Swap after each attack.
coachpunten: Dribble at a defender to commit them, then pass
Play wide: the outside attackers keep their distance
Decide quickly: the overload only lasts a few seconds

moeilijker: If the defenders win the ball, they can score in a mini goal behind the attackers
You can only score once everyone has touched the ball

veld-ps-3-2-poortjes.meerSpelers: With more players: groups wait beside the area and swap after each attack.

veld-sp-koning-van-het-veld.uitleg: Three (or more) small pitches side by side, with a 1v1 on each. After every round the winner moves one pitch up towards the king's pitch and the loser one pitch down. Whoever wins on the king's pitch at the end is the king.
veld-sp-koning-van-het-veld.organisatie: 8 × 12 m pitches with two mini goals, 3 m apart. The yellow pitch is the king's pitch. 1-minute rounds; a draw is decided by a penalty into the empty goal.
coachpunten: Every round counts: full speed from the first second
Be brave and take them on, also on the king's pitch
Move quickly: winners go right, losers go left

makkelijker: Only the winner moves, the loser stays
moeilijker: On the king's pitch only a goal after a skill move counts

veld-pv-1-1-poortjes.uitleg: There is a mini goal at each end with a gate in front of it. A passes the ball across to B and goes straight in to defend. B must first dribble through one of the gates and can then score in either mini goal. After your turn, join the other queue.
veld-pv-1-1-poortjes.organisatie: 20 × 26 m area with a mini goal on each short side and a 2.5 m gate 4 m in front of it. Two queues on the halfway line, one on each touchline; the left queue has the balls.
coachpunten: Attacker: pick a gate quickly and take the ball in your running direction
Defender: close down quickly and shut off the short route to the gate
After the gate: check which goal is open

makkelijker: The defender starts a second later
moeilijker: After the gate, score only in the far goal
Pass in the air instead of along the ground: control it under pressure first

veld-pv-wippen-1-1.uitleg: A small pitch with two mini goals. A stands on the halfway line with the ball, B by their own goal. A passes it gently to B; B tries to chip the ball first time over A into A's goal (a point). Straight after, the coach plays a second ball in from the side and they play 1v1.
veld-pv-wippen-1-1.organisatie: 16 × 22 m pitch with a mini goal on both short sides. A on the halfway line, B by their goal, coach with balls on the touchline at halfway.
coachpunten: Chip: standing foot next to the ball, get your laces under it, short follow-through
A: don't stand too close to B after your pass
Second ball: who gets there first?

makkelijker: Control the ball before the chip
moeilijker: Chip with the weaker foot only
The coach plays the second ball to A's feet

veld-pv-oplopend-overtal.uitleg: One continuous attack. The coach plays to attacker 1: 1v1. Then a second attacker joins from one side (2v1), followed by another attacker and a defender from the other side (3v2). With a sixth player, a second defender joins as well: 3v3. The attackers try to score in one of the two mini goals before the defence is complete.
veld-pv-oplopend-overtal.organisatie: 30 × 30 m area with two mini goals 12 m apart on the end line. Attacker 1 facing defender 1 in the middle, the extra players on the touchlines. Coach with balls behind the attackers.
coachpunten: Attackers: play quickly and use the overload before the next defender arrives
Joining players: start your run deep and stay wide
Defenders: buy time and close off the middle

makkelijker: Defender 2 only comes on after 5 seconds
moeilijker: With the sixth player, go straight to 3v3
If the defenders win the ball, they can counter on two mini goals

veld-pv-2-1-inhalende-verdediger.uitleg: There are two mini goals at each end. Defender 1 stands between their goals and passes to one of the two attackers by the other goals. As the pass is played, defender 2 runs round a mini goal from the touchline and defends from behind. If the attackers don't play the 2v1 quickly, it becomes 2v2.
veld-pv-2-1-inhalende-verdediger.organisatie: 22 × 28 m area with two mini goals on both short sides. Defender 1 between their goals, the attackers by the other goals, defender 2 on the touchline next to the attackers.
coachpunten: Attackers: go forward quickly, make the defender choose, then pass
Defender 1: buy time until your teammate arrives
Defender 2: shortest route back, behind the ball carrier

veld-pv-golven.uitleg: Attacks in separate waves that keep getting bigger: first 1v1, then 2v1, then 3v2, always on the goal with a keeper. After each wave the players walk back and the next group steps up. Unlike the building overloads (one continuous attack), every wave starts again from the start line.
veld-pv-golven.organisatie: Start line 30 m from goal, defenders at 18 m. Full-size goal with keeper. Attackers and defenders rotate after each wave.
coachpunten: Go forward quickly and make the defender choose
In an overload: find the free player at the right moment
Defenders: slow the attack down, close off the middle and work together

moeilijker: The next wave goes straight after the last one (no rest)
If the defenders win the ball, they can score in two mini goals

veld-pv-1-1-naar-4-4.uitleg: It starts with a 1v1 on two goals with keepers. After every goal or every time the ball goes out, each team adds a player: 2v2, then 3v3 and finally 4v4. The keeper of the team that conceded (or when the ball goes out: the keeper of the team whose ball it is) restarts straight away. After a few minutes of 4v4, a new round starts with a 1v1.
veld-pv-1-1-naar-4-4.organisatie: 24 × 32 m pitch with a youth goal and a keeper at each short end. Three players per team wait beside the pitch, level with the halfway line. Spare balls by the goals.
veld-pv-1-1-naar-4-4.meerSpelers: With more players: carry on up to 5v5, or two pitches side by side.
coachpunten: 1v1: dare to take on your opponent, run at the defender with pace
When you come on: be available straight away or pick up your player straight away
With more players: make the pitch big in possession, compact after losing the ball

makkelijker: A goal in the first 1v1 counts double, after that normal
moeilijker: Only the team that conceded adds a player (a temporary overload)

veld-pv-6-6-verboden-midden.uitleg: A 6v6 game with keepers. Down the middle of the pitch runs a narrow strip where nobody may go, not even to fetch the ball. The ball may go over or through it. So you have to switch play via the wings and with long balls over the strip. In the example, red plays in the left winger, who switches play to the right with a long ball; the right winger puts in the cross.
veld-pv-6-6-verboden-midden.organisatie: 44 × 60 m pitch with a youth goal and a keeper at each short end. No-go strip 8 m wide in the middle, from 12 m to 48 m (cones or a different colour of disc cones). Teams in bibs, 6-minute rounds. Anyone who steps into the strip gives the ball to the other team.
veld-pv-6-6-verboden-midden.meerSpelers: With more players: 7v7 or 8v8 on a bigger pitch, with a wider strip.
coachpunten: Stay wide: someone available on both sides of the strip
The long ball over the strip: with the laces, high enough, to feet or into a run
After the switch, play on quickly before the opponents can shift across

makkelijker: The ball may roll through the strip, low as well
moeilijker: The ball must switch wings at least once before a goal

veld-pv-5-5-schietzones.uitleg: A 5v5 game with keepers. You may only score from the shooting zone in front of goal. Four neutral players stand on the sides (two per touchline) and play for the team in possession; they may not score and touch the ball twice at most. Use them to get into the shooting zone: play a neutral player in and make your run.
veld-pv-5-5-schietzones.organisatie: 34 × 48 m pitch with a youth goal and a keeper at each short end. A 20 × 12 m shooting zone in front of each goal (disc cones). Four neutral players in their own colour on the touchlines, at 16 and 32 m. Teams in bibs, 5-minute rounds; change the neutrals every round.
veld-pv-5-5-schietzones.meerSpelers: With more players: 6v6 with four neutrals on a bigger pitch.
coachpunten: Get into the shooting zone with an action: a one-two with a neutral player or a run in behind
In the zone: finish quickly, in one or two touches
Defenders: keep the shooting zone closed and follow your player when they make a run

moeilijker: In the shooting zone, first-time finishes only

veld-pv-4-4-wingers.naam: 4v4 with wingers in the wide zones
veld-pv-4-4-wingers.uitleg: A 4v4 game with keepers in the middle of the pitch. Down each side is a wide zone with a fixed winger in it. The wingers play for the team in possession, always stay in their zone and may not be challenged there. A goal from a cross out of the wide zone counts double. In the example, red plays in the right winger, who dribbles on and crosses; the striker heads it in.
veld-pv-4-4-wingers.organisatie: 28 × 44 m pitch with a 6 m wide zone on each side (so 40 m wide in total), a youth goal and a keeper at each short end. Two wingers in their own colour. Teams in bibs, 5-minute rounds; change the wingers every round.
veld-pv-4-4-wingers.meerSpelers: With more players: 5v5 in the middle, or each team has its own winger in each zone (1v1 on the wing).
coachpunten: Play wide: find the winger as soon as the middle is closed
When the cross comes: one to the near post, one to the far post, one around the penalty spot
Winger: look up before you cross and put the ball between keeper and defenders

makkelijker: A goal after a pass from the winger also counts double
moeilijker: One defender may enter the wide zone
Only a header or volley from a cross counts

veld-pv-voorsprong.uitleg: A short 5-minute game in which one team starts 2-0 up. That team has to defend the lead; the other team has to at least draw level in time. You learn how to hold on to a lead cleverly (stay compact, keep the ball in the team) and how to take risks when you are behind. Variant: one team plays with a player fewer, but leads 1-0.
veld-pv-voorsprong.organisatie: 34 × 44 m pitch with a youth goal and a keeper at each short end. 5v5 (variant: 5v4). 5-minute rounds; then the other team starts with the lead.
veld-pv-voorsprong.meerSpelers: With more players: 6v6 or 7v7, or two pitches with games side by side.
coachpunten: Leading: stay compact, close the space in front of goal, and after winning the ball keep it calmly in the team
Behind: make the pitch big, play quickly and be brave: an extra player forward
Watch the clock: what does the score ask of your team right now?

moeilijker: The team that is behind plays with a player more, but with two touches maximum

veld-pv-2-2-doelspeler.uitleg: Two against two in a small area. Each team has a target player behind the line at the end it is attacking. Get the ball to your target player and it’s a point. The target player lays the ball straight back to a teammate, so your team can carry on for the next point. That means the defenders have to keep pressing to win the ball; if they do, they play towards their own target player at the other end.
veld-pv-2-2-doelspeler.organisatie: 14 × 22 m area. A target player behind the line at each short end (they may move across the full width). 2-minute rounds; then the target players swap with an outfield player.
veld-pv-2-2-doelspeler.meerSpelers: With more players: 3v3 with target players, or pairs waiting to come on after every round.
coachpunten: Attacking: make the area big and play into the target player as soon as the line is open
Defending: one presses the ball, the other blocks the line to the target player
After winning the ball, switch straight away: look where your target player is

makkelijker: Target players may take two touches
moeilijker: Only a point when the target player lays it off to a player running in

veld-pv-mandekking.uitleg: A 4v4 game on four mini goals, but everyone has a fixed opponent: only they may challenge you and only you may challenge them. Off the ball it is all about getting free and shaking off your marker: a run one way and then quickly the other way (first away, then come short). As a defender you stay between your player and your own goals and see ball and player at the same time.
veld-pv-mandekking.organisatie: 26 × 34 m pitch with two mini goals at each short end. Make fixed pairs of players with roughly the same pace. Teams in bibs, 4-minute rounds; then new pairs.
veld-pv-mandekking.meerSpelers: With more players: 5v5 or 6v6, always in fixed pairs.
coachpunten: Shaking off your marker: take them with you first, then turn sharply the other way
Ask for the ball the moment you are free, not while your opponent is still tight on you
Defending: between player and goal, half-turned so you can see ball and player

makkelijker: One free player per team without a fixed opponent
moeilijker: If your opponent scores, you do a 5-rep task (e.g. squats)

veld-mt-2-tegen-2.uitleg: You play in twos against two others. Help each other! Dribble, pass to your teammate and score in the other team’s mini-goal.
veld-mt-2-tegen-2.organisatie: 12 × 16 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 2v2 on two pitches side by side and 2 children rotate in. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: See where your teammate is

veld-mt-3-tegen-3.uitleg: Two teams of three. Pass to each other and score in the other team’s mini-goal. Don’t all stand by the ball: find an empty space!
veld-mt-3-tegen-3.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Find an empty space
Look up before you play

makkelijker: The coach plays for the team with the ball
moeilijker: A point only after two passes

veld-mt-4-goaltjes.uitleg: There are two mini-goals on each side. Score in one of the other team’s mini-goals. Is someone standing in front of one? Then go to the other one!
veld-mt-4-goaltjes.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with 2 mini-goals on each short side, 8 m apart. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look for the free mini-goal

moeilijker: Score in a different mini-goal from last time

veld-mt-poortjespartij.uitleg: No mini-goals today, but gates! Dribble the ball through a gate on the other team’s side. That’s a point.
veld-mt-poortjespartij.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with 2 gates of disc cones (2 m wide) on each short side. Score by dribbling through a gate. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Keep the ball close through the gate

veld-mt-twee-ballen.uitleg: Oh no, there are two balls in play! Both teams can score at the same time. Pay attention: where are the balls?
veld-mt-twee-ballen.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. A game with 2 balls at once; if one goes out, the coach puts a new one in. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look up: where is the other ball?

veld-mt-bal-in-de-zone.uitleg: There’s a zone at the end of the pitch. Dribble the ball into it and put your foot on it: stop it! That’s a point.
veld-mt-bal-in-de-zone.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a 3 m end zone on both short sides (disc cones). Score by stopping the ball in the end zone. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Stop the ball with the sole of your foot

moeilijker: A pass into the zone first

veld-mt-jokerpartij.uitleg: The coach joins in as the joker: they always help the team with the ball. Pass to the coach and run into space. You’ll get it back!
veld-mt-jokerpartij.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. The coach plays for the team with the ball. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Pass and keep moving

veld-mt-geen-uitbal.uitleg: Did the ball go out? No time to wait! The coach throws in a new ball straight away. Get there quickly and keep playing.
veld-mt-geen-uitbal.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. The coach stands at the side with a pile of balls and throws in a new one as soon as the ball goes out. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Keep moving and look at the coach

makkelijker: Throw the ball to a team’s feet
moeilijker: Throw the ball into free space

veld-mt-dribbelgoal.uitleg: Do you score after dribbling past an opponent? Then your goal counts double: 2 points! Be brave and dribble.
veld-mt-dribbelgoal.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. A goal after dribbling past an opponent = 2 points, other goals 1 point. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Be brave and dribble, even if it goes wrong

veld-mt-mini-toernooi.uitleg: We’re having a tournament! You play a game for 3 minutes. Then the coach blows the whistle and you get a new opponent. Which team wins the most games?
veld-mt-mini-toernooi.organisatie: Two 12 × 16 m pitches side by side, each with a mini-goal on both short sides. Four teams: with 10 children, 2 teams of 3 and 2 teams of 2. Games of 3 minutes, then change opponent. Play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Win together, lose together

moeilijker: The winner moves up a pitch

veld-mt-poppenpartij.uitleg: There are mannequins on the pitch. They don’t do anything, but you have to go around them! Dribble past the mannequins and score.
veld-mt-poppenpartij.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. There are 4 mannequins on the pitch that you have to play around. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look up: where are the mannequins?

moeilijker: A pass past a mannequin counts double

veld-mt-paaltjesvoetbal.uitleg: No mini-goal, but a pole! Hit the other team’s pole with the ball. A hit? A point! Aim carefully.
veld-mt-paaltjesvoetbal.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a pole in the middle of both short sides, 2 m from the line. Score by hitting the other team’s pole. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Aim at the pole; getting close makes it easier

makkelijker: A mannequin instead of a pole
moeilijker: A point only from outside an area

veld-mt-kaatsbordpartij.uitleg: There are rebound boards at the side. They’re your teammates! Play the ball against one and run after it. That’s how you get past the other team.
veld-mt-kaatsbordpartij.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. A rebound board halfway along each long side; you can use them as a teammate. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Play it against the board and keep moving

moeilijker: A goal after a rebound counts double

veld-mt-hoepelgoal.uitleg: There are hoops behind the line. Dribble over and stop the ball in a hoop. That’s a goal!
veld-mt-hoepelgoal.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with 3 hoops behind each short line. Score by stopping the ball in one of the other team’s hoops. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Stop the ball in the hoop with the sole of your foot

makkelijker: A point even if the ball only touches the hoop

veld-mt-ballenregen.uitleg: It’s raining balls! The coach keeps throwing a new ball onto the pitch. Which team scores the most goals in 2 minutes?
veld-mt-ballenregen.organisatie: 16 × 20 m pitch with a mini-goal on both short sides. The coach keeps throwing in new balls, even if another ball is still in play. Rounds of 2 minutes, count the goals. Two groups per pitch: with 10 children, 3v3 with 2 subs per team, or 5v5. Too crowded? Set out a second pitch next to it or play with an extra ball. Swap every 2 minutes and play for 15 minutes.
coachpunten: Look up: where is the next ball coming from?

veld-pv-golven-overtal.uitleg: An attack that grows in three waves, back and forth across the pitch. Player 1 dribbles forward and shoots from about 15 m at the goal on the far side, and may not go any further (1v0). Straight after that, two attackers come on from the side that was shot at and play 2v1 against the player who just shot. Once that ball is out or scored, two more players join from the side where player 1 started and it becomes 3v2, until there is a goal or the ball goes out.
veld-pv-golven-overtal.organisatie: Pitch of 24 × 40 m with a goal at both ends. Without keepers: small goals. With keepers: E-goals, with a keeper at each end. The players stand with balls next to the goal at both ends. Afterwards they join the end where they finish.
coachpunten: 1v0: dribble at high speed and shoot in time, before the 15 m line
Overload: dribble at the defender and play the free player at the right moment
Switch straight away after each wave: whoever just attacked now defends

makkelijker: Bigger pitch, so there is more space
The defender may only start once the ball is over the halfway line
